messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — Silverline renewal in ~6 weeks. I’m seeing a ~65% drop in active routes and ~40% drop in token usage over the last 30d. Procurement just pinged us with RFP questions. Need a quick triage and a playbook. @Jason Lee can you loop AE? @Kai Patel can you check for any perf/regression signals? Link: <https://redwood.app/customers/silverline>
Deploy Bot: Automated usage snapshot for customer: Silverline
```
period: last_30d
active_routes: 18 (was 52)
tokens_total: 42,300 (was 70,500)
avg_latency_ms: 112
error_rate: 0.6% (stable)
health_score: 42
```

Jason Lee: On it — I’ll reach out to the buyer and procurement. Do we have any recent stakeholder changes to call out?

Maria Gomez: Yes — CTO left end of Feb, interim CTO started two weeks ago. Primary champion (Priya, Dir of ML) has been quiet since the org shuffle. I booked a sync with her Wed 10am PT to surface blockers.

Kai Patel: Quick check on runtime/serving: no latency spikes or error regressions in the past 30d. Will run prompt-level evals against their top intents and report back by EOD. Also will check kv-cache hit rates for long-context flows.

Olivia Chen: FYI procurement asked for pricing + feature parity vs NimbusAI. They specifically called out cheaper per-token pricing and a dedicated on-prem option. Suggestion: offer 3-month trial on Dedicated with a burst credit and a short technical deep-dive to re-establish ROI. :thinking_face:

Jason Lee: Sounds good. Can we prepare a one-pager with (1) recent usage trends, (2) forecast with and without batching/cache, and (3) a competitive comparison vs Nimbus? @Maria can you share top 10 intents / sample prompts so Kai can run evals?

Maria Gomez: Sharing sample query set and a quick intent list in the thread now. Note: they heavily use long-context summarization and multi-turn extraction — worth calling out prefix/cache improvements and quantization profiles that reduce cost without quality loss.

Kai Patel: Eval results (quick summary): sample pass rate 93% on Silverline prompt set, no measurable quality regression vs their baseline. Batch + KV cache config reduces token cost estimate by ~28% in our sim. Will attach the eval artifacts after cleanup. :thumbsup:
